=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- CLAUDE.md:615-616 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Including “PR title” in the auto-close keyword ban is overly broad because GitHub does not parse PR titles for auto-close.
  WHY: The reviewer called it a false-positive restriction with no runtime benefit, though the cost is only a minor precision nit.
- CLAUDE.md:622-626 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The label-verification instruction has no recovery path if `gh`/MCP label lookup is unavailable or fails.
  WHY: The reviewers note there is no fallback for missing tools or lookup failures, so the PR-body drafting step can be blocked or forced to bypass the check.
- CLAUDE.md:622-626 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The label-verification rule is advisory-only and not wired into the PR-body generation/enforcement path.
  WHY: Both reviewers say the model can still draft a violating body unless a higher-level pre-write guard invokes the label check.
- CLAUDE.md:627-629 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: §19’s statement that the rule is “not superseded by §12” conflicts with §12’s own precedence language.
  WHY: Qwen notes §12.B only preserves explicit exceptions like §6 and §10, so §19 introduces a cross-reference inconsistency.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
